## What's New in v0.28.27 A jump list for a thread's open questions, files side by side or full screen, image zoom everywhere, text size for plan review and annotate, and a run of fixes from your reports. ### Plannotator Inbox #### Jump to open questions When a thread has questions you haven't answered, a button in its foot says how many. It lists them, and choosing one opens its message and takes you to the card. - [#2091](https://github.com/backnotprop/plannotator/pull/2091) #### Side by side or full screen, remembered An open file has a **Side by side | Full screen** switch in its header. The Inbox remembers the one you picked. - [#2080](https://github.com/backnotprop/plannotator/pull/2080) #### Zoom and pan images Images in the Inbox zoom with a trackpad pinch or Ctrl/⌘ + wheel, pan by dragging, and switch between Fit and 2× on a double-click. ← → still step to the next file while zoomed, and a comment's drawing stays on the image at any zoom. - [#2093](https://github.com/backnotprop/plannotator/pull/2093) #### Action items as a checklist An agent's action items show as one checklist card: tick each off, open it for the details, and see "2 of 3 done" at a glance. - [#2077](

## What's New in v0.28.26 Action items and reply drafts in the Inbox, one decision button for plan review, Enter to save a comment, a custom code font, and many fixes. 35 PRs, 9 of them from 8 outside contributors, 5 of whom are first-timers. ### Plannotator Inbox #### Action items An agent can ask you to go do something: run a command, sign in somewhere, check a page. It shows as a card in the thread with **Done**, **Can't do it** and **Add note**, and your answer goes back to the agent. - [#2059](https://github.com/backnotprop/plannotator/pull/2059) #### Reply drafts What you type in a reply box is kept per thread. It comes back when you reopen the thread, after a reload, and after a restart. A thread with an unsent draft is marked **Draft** in the list. - [#2028](https://github.com/backnotprop/plannotator/pull/2028) #### Replies to a busy agent go in on their own If the agent is in a long turn, the line under your reply shows how long it has waited, and after 5 minutes the reply goes into the running turn by itself, as if you'd pressed Send now. - [#2056](https://github.com/backnotprop/plannotator/pull/2056) #### Smaller changes - **A Send skips a question only when you press Skip.*

## What's New in v0.28.25 A follow-up to 0.28.24 for the Plannotator Inbox: Re-ask, delivery ticks on the list, a count of new messages on the tab, a right-click menu on threads, and click Inbox to refresh. All PRs by @backnotprop. ### Plannotator Inbox #### Re-ask open questions When two or more questions in a thread are still open, **Re-ask** sits beside Reply. It asks the agent to ask them again together in one new message, with fresh context. Picks you made but didn't send go along as answers. - [#2018](https://github.com/backnotprop/plannotator/pull/2018) #### Delivery ticks on the list A small mark before a row's time shows where your last reply is: a clock while it's queued, dots while it's sending, ✓ when it's saved for an agent, ✓✓ once it's delivered. - [#2016](https://github.com/backnotprop/plannotator/pull/2016) #### A count of new messages on the tab The tab reads "(3) Plannotator Inbox" and its icon gets a red badge while threads hold agent messages you haven't looked at. - [#2011](https://github.com/backnotprop/plannotator/pull/2011) #### Right-click a thread Right-click a row (or Shift+F10) to copy its link or thread ID, mark it read or archive it. - [#2024](https://github.c

## What's New in v0.28.24 A big Inbox release: a new look, Send now, tagging agents, comments on an agent's own words, and much smaller reads for agents. Links inside HTML pages now work everywhere you annotate. 23 PRs, all by @backnotprop. ### Plannotator Inbox #### A new look The Inbox has a softer, calmer design, with tooltips that match the app instead of the browser's. A new text size setting (Settings → General, 12 to 15) makes everything larger or smaller at once. - [#1971](https://github.com/backnotprop/plannotator/pull/1971), [#1977](https://github.com/backnotprop/plannotator/pull/1977), [#1982](https://github.com/backnotprop/plannotator/pull/1982), [#1990](https://github.com/backnotprop/plannotator/pull/1990) #### Send now After you send a reply, the line under it says whether it is queued (the agent is busy and gets it when its turn ends) or on its way. **Send now** puts it into the agent's running turn right away, on Claude Code, Pi and OpenCode 2. - [#1968](https://github.com/backnotprop/plannotator/pull/1968) #### Tag agents Type `@` in a reply or a comment to choose which agents get it. - [#2005](https://github.com/backnotprop/plannotator/pull/2005) #### Comment on an agent's message Select any words in an agent's message and comment on them, the same way you comment on an attached file. Your comments go with your next reply. - [#1997](https://github.com/backnotprop/plannotator/pull/1

## What's New in v0.28.23 The main fix: Claude Code sessions that run background subagents get their Inbox replies again. Also in this release: dictated text no longer goes missing on Chrome 155-156 for macOS, 👍 Looks good now reaches the agent, Inbox notifications that never fail silently, and a run of Inbox improvements. 16 PRs, all by @backnotprop. ### Inbox replies reach Claude Code sessions with background subagents When a Claude Code session started a subagent (a background one included), the Plannotator mod counted the subagent's turn as the session's own and never saw it end. The session then read as busy for good, so Inbox replies to it waited forever and "Ask this session" said the session was busy. The mod now ignores subagent turns. Verified live on Claude Code 2.1.302. The fix is in the Claude Code plugin, which updates separately from the binary. The install script updates a user-scope plugin for you; otherwise run `claude plugin update plannotator@plannotator --scope user`, then restart Claude Code. - [#1979](https://github.com/backnotprop/plannotator/pull/1979) ### Dictated text lands where you are typing On Chrome 155 and 156 for macOS, text from dictation apps such as Hex (and text expanders) often failed to appear: the first dictation
